fixed_patches_in_application_order.purpose: Record writes accepted by the test-harness DRAM interface for architectural memory-update comparison.

reconstruction.test_programs: Use the 43 upstream test-list entries byte for byte at test_revision. Append harness/uncached_read_id.yaml to the instruction-trace test list and stage harness/uncached_read_id.S in the regression test directory under cpu-eval-patches. The local program loads the reset value from the CLINT software-interrupt register at 0x02000000 and writes the loaded value to its signature.
reconstruction.instrumentation: Restore the recorded test-harness target, verify target_sha256_before, apply the fixed patch from the CVA6 repository root with git apply, and verify target_sha256_after.

comparison.loads: Compare corresponding retired instructions, integer-register updates, and width-masked memory updates using the architectural trace comparator.
comparison.stores: Pair retired Spike stores and accepted test-harness DRAM writes in execution order; compare address, byte enable, and the write value masked to the store width.
comparison.completion_requirement: Both CPU regressions must complete and match. The fixed tree builds and runs every program with the reference module, so after only the target is replaced a build failure, a missing target module, an RTL simulation that does not complete (including the fixed RVFI cycle limit and assertions) and a comparison mismatch are FAIL. Missing fixed tools or inputs, resource exhaustion and wall-clock timeouts are INVALID.
